+def _make_local_attention_virtual_batches_torch(
+    attn_chunk_size: int,
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    page_size: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """
+    Torch-only variant of make_local_attention_virtual_batches to avoid
+    NumPy conversions and reduce host-device sync overhead.
+
+    Inputs are expected to be CPU tensors with dtype torch.int32. The
+    returned tensors are also on CPU and int32.
+    """
+    assert page_size > 0, "page_size must be > 0"
+
+    # Ensure CPU int32 for fast indexing math
+    if query_start_loc.device.type != "cpu":
+        query_start_loc = query_start_loc.to("cpu", non_blocking=True)
+    if seq_lens.device.type != "cpu":
+        seq_lens = seq_lens.to("cpu", non_blocking=True)
+    if block_table.device.type != "cpu":
+        block_table = block_table.to("cpu", non_blocking=True)
+
+    query_start_loc = query_start_loc.to(torch.int32)
+    seq_lens = seq_lens.to(torch.int32)
+    block_table = block_table.to(torch.int32)
+
+    # Effective chunk size aligned to page size
+    max_seq_len = int(seq_lens.max().item()) if seq_lens.numel() > 0 else 0
+    effective_chunk = min(attn_chunk_size, max_seq_len)
+    effective_chunk = (effective_chunk // page_size) * page_size
+    if effective_chunk < page_size:
+        effective_chunk = page_size
+    attn_chunk_size = effective_chunk
+
+    # Compute per-request query lengths and helper shapes
+    q_seqlens = query_start_loc[1:] - query_start_loc[:-1]
+    actual_bs = int(seq_lens.shape[0])
+
+    # Tokens in first/last local block per request
+    # last block size: ((L-1) % C) + 1 is equivalent to numpy trick
+    tokens_in_last_block = torch.remainder(seq_lens - 1, attn_chunk_size) + 1
+    q_tokens_in_first_block = torch.minimum(
+        attn_chunk_size - ((seq_lens - q_seqlens) % attn_chunk_size), q_seqlens
+    )
+
+    # number of local blocks per request: 1 + ceil_div(rest, chunk)
+    rest = q_seqlens - q_tokens_in_first_block
+    # ceil div for tensors
+    local_blocks = 1 + (-(rest // -attn_chunk_size))
+
+    cu_num_blocks = torch.cumsum(local_blocks, dim=0)
+    virtual_batches = int(cu_num_blocks[-1].item())
+
+    # Batched arange over local blocks
+    block_offsets = torch.repeat_interleave(cu_num_blocks - local_blocks, local_blocks)
+    arange = torch.arange(virtual_batches, dtype=torch.int32) - block_offsets
+    rarange = torch.repeat_interleave(local_blocks, local_blocks) - arange - 1
+
+    # seqlens_q_local
+    seqlens_q_local = torch.repeat_interleave(
+        q_seqlens - q_tokens_in_first_block, local_blocks
+    )
+    qt_rep = torch.repeat_interleave(q_tokens_in_first_block, local_blocks)
+    mask0 = arange == 0
+    if mask0.any():
+        seqlens_q_local[mask0] = qt_rep[mask0]
+    maskp = arange > 0
+    if maskp.any():
+        seqlens_q_local[maskp] = torch.minimum(
+            seqlens_q_local[maskp] - attn_chunk_size * (arange[maskp] - 1),
+            torch.as_tensor(attn_chunk_size, dtype=torch.int32),
+        )
+    cu_seqlens_q_local = torch.nn.functional.pad(
+        torch.cumsum(seqlens_q_local, dim=0, dtype=torch.int32), (1, 0)
+    )
+
+    # seqlens_k_local: full chunk except the last block of each request
+    seqlens_k_local = torch.full(
+        (virtual_batches,), int(attn_chunk_size), dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    end_pos = cu_num_blocks - 1
+    seqlens_k_local.scatter_(0, end_pos, tokens_in_last_block)
+
+    # Build local block table indices
+    k_seqstarts_abs = torch.repeat_interleave(seq_lens, local_blocks) - (
+        rarange * attn_chunk_size
+        + torch.repeat_interleave(tokens_in_last_block, local_blocks)
+    )
+    block_starts = torch.div(k_seqstarts_abs, page_size, rounding_mode="floor")
+
+    assert (
+        attn_chunk_size % page_size == 0
+    ), f"attn_chunk_size {attn_chunk_size} must be divisible by page_size {page_size}"
+    pages_per_local = attn_chunk_size // page_size
+
+    base = torch.arange(pages_per_local, dtype=torch.int32)
+    block_indices = block_starts[:, None] + base[None, :]
+    # clamp to valid width
+    max_col = int(block_table.shape[1] - 1)
+    if max_col >= 0:
+        block_indices = block_indices.clamp_max(max_col)
+
+    # batch index per local block page
+    batch_ids_per_virtual = torch.repeat_interleave(
+        torch.arange(actual_bs, dtype=torch.int32), local_blocks
+    )
+    batch_indices = torch.repeat_interleave(
+        batch_ids_per_virtual, int(pages_per_local)
+    )
+    block_indices_flat = block_indices.reshape(-1)
+    block_table_local = block_table[batch_indices.long(), block_indices_flat.long()]
+    block_table_local = block_table_local.view(virtual_batches, pages_per_local)
+
+    return (
+        seqlens_q_local.to(torch.int32),
+        cu_seqlens_q_local.to(torch.int32),
+        seqlens_k_local.to(torch.int32),
+        block_table_local.to(torch.int32),
+    )
+
+
 def cdiv(a: int, b: int) -> int:
     """Ceiling division."""
     return -(a // -b)
